name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
summary: The Horde asks you to help secure its ownership of Warsong Gulch. Your aid matters to the Horde’s claim there.

sections.title: Horde Claim
sections.body: The Horde’s claim to Warsong Gulch is what calls for your aid. By helping, you support its ownership of the gulch.

faq.q: What does the Horde want here?
faq.answer: The Horde seeks to secure its ownership of Warsong Gulch.
Your aid helps ensure the Horde’s ownership of Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Warsong Gulch?
faq.answer: The available account says the Horde seeks to ensure its ownership of Warsong Gulch.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, your aid helps ensure its ownership of Warsong Gulch.
